QuestInfo.name: The Mind of a Knight: Part Two
QuestInfo.1: This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# has approved of your training, but the journey for a noble mind does not end so soon...

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

1.0: #h0#, your training seems to be producing adequate results. Your mind seems sharper, and more prepared for the dangers ahead. You could make the Cygnus Knights proud one day.

yes.0: I have found that most fighters have a small up-tick in their productivity after receiving gifts. As such, I have had something prepared for you.
